# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

Only the current `main` branch is supported while Global Terminal remains in
controlled pre-production development.

## Reporting A Vulnerability

Use GitHub Private vulnerability reporting for security findings. Do not open a
public issue, discussion, or pull request containing exploit details, secrets,
account identifiers, hosted URLs, private market research, or provider payloads.

Include the affected boundary, reproduction steps, expected impact, and the
smallest redacted evidence needed to verify the issue. Do not test against other
users, exceed provider quotas, or mutate hosted data beyond an explicitly
authorized bounded test.

The repository owner will acknowledge a complete report when it is reviewed.
No response-time or bounty commitment is made during pre-production.
